description: Check that TrenchBroom is reachable and report which map is open.
name: ping

description: Summarise the open map: layers, groups, brush counts, entity classname counts, world bounds, grid size and the current selection. Drill into a group for detail rather than asking for every brush.
name: get_scene

description: Create an axis-aligned box brush in the current layer.

bounds.description: An axis-aligned box in world units. Corners may be given in either order.

max.description: The opposite corner, as [x, y, z].

material.description: Material to apply to every face. Defaults to the editor's current material.

name: create_brush

description: Create a cylinder inscribed in the given bounds. Pass 'thickness' to make it a hollow tube instead, which produces a ring of brushes.

axis.description: Axis the shape is revolved around. Defaults to "z" (upright).

bounds.description: An axis-aligned box in world units. Corners may be given in either order.

max.description: The opposite corner, as [x, y, z].

circle.description: How the cross-section is approximated. Defaults to 8 edge-aligned sides.

alignment.description: "edge" puts a flat face on the axes, "vertex" puts a corner there, "scalable" subdivides so the shape survives non-uniform scaling.

sides.description: Number of sides, for edge and vertex alignment.

material.description: Material to apply to every face. Defaults to the editor's current material.

thickness.description: Wall thickness. Omit for a solid cylinder.

name: create_cylinder

description: Create a cone inscribed in the given bounds, tapering along the given axis.

axis.description: Axis the shape is revolved around. Defaults to "z" (upright).

bounds.description: An axis-aligned box in world units. Corners may be given in either order.

max.description: The opposite corner, as [x, y, z].

circle.description: How the cross-section is approximated. Defaults to 8 edge-aligned sides.

alignment.description: "edge" puts a flat face on the axes, "vertex" puts a corner there, "scalable" subdivides so the shape survives non-uniform scaling.

sides.description: Number of sides, for edge and vertex alignment.

material.description: Material to apply to every face. Defaults to the editor's current material.

name: create_cone

description: Create a sphere inscribed in the given bounds. 'uv' builds it from stacked rings, 'ico' from subdivided triangles with more even faces.

axis.description: Axis the shape is revolved around. Defaults to "z" (upright).

bounds.description: An axis-aligned box in world units. Corners may be given in either order.

max.description: The opposite corner, as [x, y, z].

circle.description: How the cross-section is approximated. Defaults to 8 edge-aligned sides.

alignment.description: "edge" puts a flat face on the axes, "vertex" puts a corner there, "scalable" subdivides so the shape survives non-uniform scaling.

sides.description: Number of sides, for edge and vertex alignment.

iterations.description: Subdivision count, for kind "ico". Defaults to 1. Each step multiplies the face count by four, so keep it low.

material.description: Material to apply to every face. Defaults to the editor's current material.

rings.description: Horizontal ring count, for kind "uv". Defaults to 8.

name: create_sphere

description: Create a semicircular arch as a band of wedge brushes. It springs from the bottom of the bounds and rises to fill them; 'axis' is the direction the opening runs through, as for a tunnel.

axis.description: Axis the shape is revolved around. Defaults to "z" (upright).

bounds.description: An axis-aligned box in world units. Corners may be given in either order.

max.description: The opposite corner, as [x, y, z].

circle.description: How the cross-section is approximated. Defaults to 8 edge-aligned sides.

alignment.description: "edge" puts a flat face on the axes, "vertex" puts a corner there, "scalable" subdivides so the shape survives non-uniform scaling.

sides.description: Number of sides, for edge and vertex alignment.

material.description: Material to apply to every face. Defaults to the editor's current material.

name: create_arch

description: Set a key on the worldspawn entity, such as 'wad' to attach a texture WAD, or 'message' to name the level.
name: set_worldspawn_property

description: Run several operations as a single undo step. Either all of them apply or, if any fails, none do. Use this for anything built from more than one or two brushes.

name.description: Name shown in TrenchBroom's undo history.

name: batch
